losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: He did exercise in the fitness center once or twice a week. He cannot do it anymore because of the disabilities suffered by him.
Because of his disabilities he cannot resume his former job which required constant patrol and handling heavy weight.
He has become depressed and withdrawn.
Before the incident, the Plaintiff enjoyed good health and was sociable. He has become depressed and withdrawn.
